description: This file defines interfaces, macros, and function declarations for a high-level wrapper around the mustach templating library, specifically for JSON integration and rendering with callback mechanisms.

methods.name: mustach_wrap_apply
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string using an abstract interface and callbacks, with specified flags and closures.

methods.name: mustach_wrap_file
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string into a file stream using an abstract interface and closure.

methods.name: mustach_wrap_fd
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string into a file descriptor using an abstract interface and closure.

methods.name: mustach_wrap_mem
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string into a memory buffer using an abstract interface and closure.

methods.name: mustach_wrap_write
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string to a custom writer callback with an abstract interface and closure.

methods.name: mustach_wrap_emit
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string to a custom emitter callback with an abstract interface and closure.
